opening.argument: The presentation advertises a “FREE No Code Flash Loan Arbitrage Bot” and then gives viewers a concrete participation path: deploy a smart contract, send at least 98 FTM to it, and confirm the transaction through MetaMask. It presents the method as easy and fast while pairing those instructions with a reported return of approximately $1,200, creating a direct rapid-profit solicitation tied to the required asset transfer and wallet authorization. Although it includes a general warning that flash-loan exploits can attack vulnerable protocols and steal millions, that warning does not erase the separate promotion of participation and the claimed return.
